name: Wikipedia: Biren Technology
notes: SECONDARY, and the only place BR100/BR104 numbers exist. Cites Tom's Hardware (Shilov, 2022-08-10: '77 Billion Transistors, 2 PFLOPS of AI Performance') and HPCwire (Peckham, 2022-08-23: 'Biren Details BR100 GPU') plus FT/Reuters/Bloomberg/SCMP for the sanctions and funding timeline. Key timeline facts: TSMC halted all Biren manufacturing October 2022; Biren reportedly modified BR100 to process less data so it would fall below the US threshold; added to the BIS Entity List October 2023; co-founder Xu Lingjie left after the sanctions-related losses; HKEX IPO 2 January 2026 (ticker 6082), shares soared on debut. The BR100 figures are 2022 launch-release numbers for a part that could not legally be manufactured at TSMC afterwards - treat as historical claims, not shipping specs.
